Tests bundle client forwarding, subscriptions, timeouts, resets, and status handling.

# Purpose
This file is a test executable for the `fd_bundle` client logic. It creates a temporary workspace, builds a test environment, and runs a set of unit tests that exercise gRPC request and response handling for packet and bundle subscriptions, builder fee info requests, stream reset handling, timeout handling, ping keepalive handling, oversized message handling, and key switch handling. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs all tests in sequence and then checks that the workspace has no memory leaks before exit.

The file also defines weak symbols for `fdctl_version_string` and [`fd_bundle_now`](<#fd_bundle_now>), which let the test use fixed version and clock values. Most of the code verifies the behavior of `fd_bundle_client_grpc_rx_msg`, `fd_bundle_client_grpc_rx_end`, `fd_bundle_client_step`, `fd_bundle_client_reset`, and `fd_bundle_client_status`, along with the gRPC and HTTP/2 request frames that the client sends. It uses imported protobuf data, raw encoded test messages, and helper functions to confirm that the client forwards packets and bundles correctly and updates internal state and metrics as expected.
